  WHY: This is a latent design risk, not a current bug. A future contributor adding a host-dependent directory admission rule would have to remember to thread `host` through this branch.

  PROBLEM: When the twin check rejects a `.claude/commands/<name>.md` write, the editor sees the same `unsafe result path` error regardless of whether the twin was missing or `checked_path` raised. Operators debugging a parity-repair failure cannot tell the two apart from the transfer log.
